arithmetic.scope: finite practical inputs; |XYZ|<=1e6, dimensions 1..8192, scale 1..100; not an exhaustive numeric proof

independentAccuracy.method: No fitting on validation points. Conservative error = Euclidean point residual + bounded radial reference uncertainty. Non-collinear references; region center, perimeter, both axes and declared height bands must be covered. Outside supported hull/height is unconfirmed.
independentAccuracy.rationale: Prospective research budgets at native 1024 px, not game-accuracy standards. Thresholds alone cannot certify source independence or geometry.

sample.selection: Historical ticks frozen before rerun. All live team 2/3 rows at first freeze tick; unique bomb_planted actor joined at each plant tick. No nearest-tick substitution; no trajectory query.

protocol.regionInterpretation: Historical image rectangles, not point correspondences. East/west plant grouping uses X sign as in old script; it is transform-sensitive and not an independent site assignment. Bounds have no calibrated uncertainty.

independenceAudit.whyBlocked: Server positions and image features exist separately; no verified same-feature world/image pair with bounded uncertainty and target DEM association.
independenceAudit.minimalEvidence: Six distinct non-collinear held-out fixed landmarks in a declared area, target-DEM-linked world XYZ and independent same-feature image points. Uncertainty includes annotation plus world measurement propagated into pixels. Historical build-number recovery is not mandatory.

levels.exactly-validated: Resource identity relation and specifically claimed capability independently validated; no all-capability implication.
levels.regionally-compatible: Independent target-DEM-linked local evidence meets frozen uncertainty/residual/coverage criteria for this capability. Historical build number optional.
levels.unconfirmed: Missing evidence, or uncertainty interval crosses threshold; e+u>T alone is not mismatch.
levels.mismatched: Trusted contradictory evidence for declared capability and region after excluding bad pairing/measurement: e.g. lower error bound max(0,e-u)>T. Never infer mismatch solely from upper bound.

compatibilityProposal.invalidation: Changed DEM/resource/scope/method/thresholds require revalidation. Never propagate between capabilities or extrapolate outside supported scope.

numericLimit.arithmeticPassScope: Enumerated examples, this run DEM projections and rejection/scaling tests only; no continuous-domain or all-finite-Number proof.
